full_service_scope.note: Collection preceded later mapper, reader and display corrections. This is not a claim of a full final-working-source rerun. Later focused and GUI evidence are separate.

chronology_notes: First feature GUI failed because the test expected an unchanged record with empty reason to be applicable. Only the test was changed to keep an unsaved name draft while switching the unchanged diameter display unit.

First PCB exchange GUI attempt stopped at Python import before opening a window: a closing-bracket syntax typo in the concurrently edited omission display query. It was corrected and compileall plus focused tests ran before the final GUI.

Mapper review corrected non-component technical containers, full-stack via endpoints, internal closed cutouts, negative mask file polarity versus LP clear, Paste naming and exact circular aperture regions.

Initial mapping runs also exposed invalid test artifact paths, missing explicit G01/G05, misuse of outline byte return type, unsorted fixture records, and a product cutout sorting omission. Their logs remain separate.

Actual receiver review corrected numeric-only zone net interpretation and distinguished multilayer LayerSet from a single display layer name. Geometry and source raw preservation remain independently checked.
CTest and GUI runs overlap in implementation coverage and are not summed into one full regression claim.

After the whole GUI run, a synthetic near-full-journal review exposed an import report sealed before completion-event admission. Existing source data was not damaged. Shared publication preflight now checks journal size, cancel/state and nonce before sealing. The 31-test focused and 7-test actual-native runs verify this later service change; the earlier GUI run is not relabeled as having run these final Python files.
The final drawing_layout.py edit removed only a trailing blank line. The final source hashes include it, and the audit generator reviewed_commit uses the stage10a baseline de8b5ac.

After verification, pcb_exchange_service.py and test_pcb_import_mapping.py each lost only one extra trailing blank line. Final working-source hashes include this whitespace-only edit; execution-time guard evidence remains unchanged.
